Theme

Tools, fasteners & household repair

tape measure noun

also measuring tape

modern

M-O s.v. tape measure, citing Levine

taenia mēnsūrālis; taeniae mēnsūrālis f.

tape measure, measuring tape

Morgan–Owens explicitly records the complete phrase, citing Levine. Inherited root and suffix quantities are supplied here.

Other words

  • fūniculus metricus — measuring tape, tape measure

    also used · modern

    So in later technical lexicography. Lewis & Short marks the first vowel of metricus as variable, so it is left unmarked here.

  • mēnsūra metrica — metre rule, tape measure

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. measuring stick, meter rule, tape measure

    Another recorded expression; Morgan–Owens notes that the phrase can feel pleonastic.

Examples

  • Taeniam mēnsūrālem affer. Mētiāmur!

    Bring the tape measure. Let’s measure!composed

See also ruler, measure.

SourcesMorgan–Owens: tape measure / meter rule · Morgan–Owens: tape measure · Lewis & Short: funiculus · Lewis & Short: mensura
